# C05 design: Consent records and guardian consent

Covers CONS01 to CONS04, NFR08 (data side), NFR09, NFR10, NFR11 (live queries), NFR12, NFR20 and AUTH07, plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 on every new screen. Emailed requests (CONS05) are v1. Guardian accounts, evidence upload and re-consent prompts are V104.

Surfaces:

1. Guardian consent screens: `/consent/[token]` (about, club stats, scouts, who you are, done, your answer, stop sharing, closed states)
2. Club consent recording form: `/squad/players/[playerId]/consent`
3. Printable paper consent form: `/squad/players/[playerId]/consent/print`
4. Consent section on the player page: current state, actions, guardian link copy box, withdraw and link dialogs
5. Consent history on the player page
6. ConsentBadge in the squad list (table and phone cards) and in the player hero

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **D01, D02, C01, C02 and C04 rules still apply.** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `display-xl`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Theme.** No C05 surface is forced dark. Every page follows the system setting. One exception: the paper sheet on the print page sits in `ThemeScope theme="light"`, because it previews paper.
- **Who.**
  - Guardians answer on their own phone, often on a slow connection, sometimes on the club admin's phone at training. Design system row: "Consent: plain language, one decision per screen, large tap targets."
  - Club admins (owner, admin) record and withdraw consent on a laptop at the club office, or on a phone at training when a parent is standing next to them.
  - Coaches read consent states on a phone at the side of the pitch. They never record or withdraw.
- **Roles.** Club pages call `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)` and `requireSquadOrgPage`. Club actions call `requireRole(CONSENT_ADMIN_ROLES)`, then `requireSquadOrg`. Coaches see every consent state and the history, with no actions. Scouts and other roles go to `/forbidden` (C01 copy). Guardian pages have no session check: the token is the capability, and both guardian actions re-check it on the server.
- **Consent is never pre-chosen.** No radio or checkbox that grants anything is checked by default, on any surface, including when the club changes an existing grant. POPIA needs an active choice.
- **Children's data.** Guardian names and player names appear on screen only. They never go into URLs, query strings, logs or audit metadata. The guardian link URL is shown once, from the action result, and is never put in a query string or a redirect.
- **One primary button per view.** A dialog is its own view. The player page already has a primary (Save changes in Details), so every consent action on it is secondary, ghost or danger.
- **Page structure.** As C04: gutters `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8`, `main` with `py-6 md:py-8 mx-auto max-w-7xl`, sections `mt-8` with an h2 in `heading-2` and `tabIndex={-1}` as a focus target. Guardian pages use their own frame (Surface 1).
- **Forms.** Reuse `useFormAction`, `Field`, `SubmitButton`, `FormBusy`, `useFocusFirstInvalid`, `Banner`, `SuccessBanner`, `FormErrorBanner` and `fieldError`. Club forms have `noValidate`. Guardian forms keep native `required`, because they must work without JavaScript (DecisionFlow rule).
- **Results after a redirect.** `?done=<code>` maps to fixed copy (never echo URL text). Codes on the player page: `consent` (recorded or changed). Guardian steps use `?step=<name>` only.
- **Dates.** `formatDate()` ("24 Oct 2026"). Add `formatDateTime()` to `src/lib/labels.ts`: "24 Oct 2026, 14:05", `en-ZA`, 24-hour, `Africa/Johannesburg`. Both in `data` inside table cells.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, no exclamation marks, no emoji. Guardian copy is written for a reading age of about 12: short sentences, everyday words, "your child" in the wording and the first name in questions.
- **Missing values** show `Missing` (an en dash in `ink-muted`) in tables. A missing part of a sentence is left out.
- **Keyboard.** No shortcuts on any C05 surface. DOM order = visual order = tab order.

### Labels, `src/lib/consent-rules.ts`

**States.** The ConsentBadge labels stay as they are: No consent, Requested, Club only, Scout-visible, Withdrawn. `CONSENT_STATE_SENTENCES` (shown next to the badge on the player page; `{first}` is the first name, `{club}` the organisation name):

| State | Sentence |
|---|---|
| none, no rows | No consent recorded yet. Wideline keeps no stats for {first}. |
| none, after a refusal | {Decider} said no on {date}. Wideline keeps no stats for {first}. |
| requested | Waiting for a guardian to answer. Wideline keeps no stats for {first} until they say yes. |
| club_only | {club} can see {first}'s stats. Scouts cannot. |
| scout_visible | {club} can see {first}'s stats, and so can scouts. |
| withdrawn | Consent was withdrawn on {date}. Wideline keeps no new stats for {first}, and scouts cannot see them. |

`{Decider}` is "{grantedBy} ({relationship label})", or "{first}" for self.

**Methods** (`CONSENT_METHOD_LABELS`): paper_form **Signed paper form**, in_person **In person**, email **By email**, guardian_link **Guardian link**. The club form offers the first three. `guardian_link` is set only by the guardian screens.

**Relationships** (`RELATIONSHIP_LABELS`): parent **Parent**, legal_guardian **Legal guardian**, grandparent **Grandparent**, other_relative **Other relative**, self **The player**. Forms for a minor offer the first four. `self` is never a choice: it is set when the player is 18 or over.

**Choices.** `true` **Yes**, `false` **No**.

### Wording, `src/server/consent/wording.ts`

Version `2026-10-draft-1`, header comment "Draft for legal review" (Q-004 pattern). Each version holds two audiences with the same five parts, so an adult's self-consent never says "your child":

`CONSENT_WORDINGS: Record<string, { guardian: ConsentWordingParts; player: ConsentWordingParts }>`, where `ConsentWordingParts = Record<"clubStats" | "scoutVisibility" | "independentReview" | "offshore" | "withdrawal", { heading: string; body: string }>`.

The text has no placeholders, so a stored version always means the same words.

**Guardian audience:**

| Part | Heading | Body |
|---|---|---|
| clubStats | What we record | Your child's club films its matches. Wideline uses the video to record goals, shots and where your child ran in each match. We only keep these stats if you say yes. If you say no, we keep no stats about your child, but they may still be seen in the match video. Match video is deleted after 7 days, and short clips after 14 days unless someone saves them. |
| scoutVisibility | Who can see the stats | Your child's coaches and club staff can see the stats. Scouts are people who look for players for other clubs and academies. Scouts can only see your child's stats if you say yes. |
| independentReview | Scouts check the video | To make sure the stats are right, independent scouts who are registered with Wideline watch the match video and check what happened. This happens even if you say no to scouts. These scouts have signed an agreement to keep what they see private. They cannot download the video, and they may not contact you, your child or the club about what they saw. |
| offshore | Where the data is kept | Wideline keeps your child's data on computers in the European Union. Some of the video work may happen in other countries. This means your child's data is stored and used outside South Africa. Every company that helps us must protect it under a written agreement. |
| withdrawal | You can change your mind | You can change your answer at any time, and it costs nothing. Use the link the club sent you, or tell the club. When you say stop, the club and scouts stop seeing your child's stats straight away. We remove them from clips, searches and saved lists within 24 hours. To delete all of your child's data, ask the club. |

**Player audience:** the same text with "your child" replaced by "you" and "your" ("Wideline uses the video to record goals, shots and where you ran in each match", "Scouts can only see your stats if you say yes", "they may not contact you or the club"). The builder writes it out in full in `wording.ts`; the unit test checks both audiences mention independent scouts and "outside South Africa".

### Component: `ConsentWording` (new, `src/components/consent/ConsentWording.tsx`)

Not in the design system; built from existing classes. Server component.

Props: `version: string`, `audience: "guardian" | "player"`, `headingLevel: 2 | 3`, `framed?: boolean` (default true).

- Wrapper `div.wl-terms`, plus `wl-card` when `framed`.
- Each part: heading (`h2` or `h3`) in `body-strong`, then `p.body-lg`.
- Last line: `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Wording version {version}** with the version in `span.data`.
- Unknown version (should not happen): `p.body text-ink-muted` **The text of this version is not available.**

### Chip: `ConsentBadge`

No change to the component. It renders for named players only: never for placeholders, never for scouts.

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

Start with `/* Consent for C05 (docs/build/design/C05.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-decision__choice input[type="checkbox"]` | Same as the radio rule: `accent-color: var(--pitch); width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; flex: none`. The `:has(input:checked)` and `:has(input:focus-visible)` rules already cover it. Used for the guardian's "I am 18 or over" confirmation. |
| `.wl-decision__choice--top` | `align-items: flex-start`, with the input `margin-top: calc(var(--space-1) / 2)`, so a two-line checkbox label lines up with its first line. |
| `.wl-decision__input` | The guardian name input, added to `.wl-input`. `min-height: var(--space-12)` (48px); markup adds `body-lg`. |
| `.wl-guardian` | The guardian page frame. `min-height: 100vh; padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-4) var(--space-12); background: var(--surface)`. From 768px: `padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-6)`. |
| `.wl-guardian__head` | `max-width` as `.wl-decision`, `margin-inline: auto; margin-bottom: var(--space-8); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1)`. |
| `.wl-copybox` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-2)`. From 768px: `flex-direction: row; align-items: center`. The input inside: `flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0`; markup adds `wl-input data`. |

| `.wl-paper__section` | `margin-top: var(--space-8); break-inside: avoid`. |
| `.wl-paper__box` | An empty tick box. `display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius-sm)`. |

## Surface 1: guardian consent screens, `/consent/[token]`

**Who, where, job.** A parent or guardian of an under-18 player, on their own phone, after the club sent the link by WhatsApp or SMS. One job: say yes or no to club stats, then to scouts. Later, the same link lets them change their mind or stop sharing.

**Access.** Public. Add `consent` to `PUBLIC_PATH` in `src/lib/public-paths.ts`. `page.tsx` calls `guardianView(token)` on every request and renders exactly one view. `layout.tsx` has no app shell. Metadata: title **Consent**; `referrer: "no-referrer"`, so the token never leaks in a Referer header. The page has no links to other sites.

**Theme.** Follows the system setting. Not forced.

### Frame (`layout.tsx`)

`main.wl-guardian` with:

1. `div.wl-guardian__head`: `p.font-display.heading-2` **Wideline** (wordmark; not a link, so the first Tab stop is the first control), then `p.eyebrow.text-ink-muted` the club name (when the token is known).
2. The view, inside the DecisionFlow column (`.wl-decision`, 576px).
3. Footer `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-12` inside the same column: **Questions? Ask {club}.** (unknown token: **Questions? Ask the club that sent you this link.**)

### Steps and query params

The page is stateless. Each step is a GET form back to `/consent/{token}`, carrying earlier answers as hidden fields. Only the last step posts to a server action.

| `step` | Shown when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `answered-club` | Routing only: shows scouts when `club=yes`, you when `club=no`. | `club` |
| (none) | Entry. Mode `decide` and state none, requested or withdrawn: show **about**. State club_only or scout_visible: show **your answer**. Mode `withdraw_only`: **your answer** with only the stop action. Mode `closed`: a closed view. | |
| `club` | mode `decide` | |
| `scouts` | mode `decide` and `club=yes` | `club` |
| `you` | mode `decide` and `club` set (and `scouts` set when `club=yes`) | `club`, `scouts` |
| `done` | after a saved decision | |
| `withdraw` | state club_only or scout_visible, mode not `closed` | |
| `stopped` | after a saved withdrawal | |

A step whose conditions do not hold falls back to the entry view. An unknown `step` value is the entry view. The page never trusts carried answers: `guardianDecisionAction` validates them again.

Step numbers: about **Step 1 of 4**, club **Step 2 of 4**, scouts **Step 3 of 4**, you **Step 4 of 4**. When `club=no`, there is no scouts step, so you is **Step 3 of 3**.

### View: about (Step 1 of 4)

Not a DecisionFlow (nothing to choose). Same column and type:

1. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Step 1 of 4**.
2. `h1.heading-1.break-words` **{club} would like to record {first}'s match stats**.
3. `p.body-lg.mt-3` **Please read this, then answer 2 questions. It takes about 2 minutes.**
4. `ConsentWording audience="guardian" headingLevel={2} framed={false}` in `div.mt-6`. Headings in `body-strong`, bodies in `body-lg`.
5. GET form with `input type=hidden name=step value=club`; `Button variant="primary" block` **Continue** (48px, full width on phones, auto from 768).

### View: club (Step 2 of 4), DecisionFlow

- step **Step 2 of 4**
- question **Can {club} record {first}'s stats?**
- explainer **We record goals, shots and where {first} ran during matches. Only {first}'s coaches and club staff can see them, unless you also say yes to scouts.**
- choices (`name="club"`, none pre-checked):
  - `yes` **Yes, the club can record them**
  - `no` **No, do not record them**, hint **We will keep no stats about {first}.**
- `action` = `/consent/{token}` (GET) with hidden `step=answered-club`. The page routes on the answer: `club=yes` shows scouts, `club=no` shows you.
- submitLabel **Continue**; secondary **Back** → `/consent/{token}`.

### View: scouts (Step 3 of 4), DecisionFlow

- question **Can scouts see {first}'s stats?** (design system copy)
- explainer **Scouts look for players for other clubs and academies. They can only see {first}'s stats if you say yes.**
- choices (`name="scouts"`): `yes` **Yes, scouts can see them**; `no` **No, keep them inside the club** (design system copy).
- hidden `club=yes`, `step=you`. submitLabel **Continue**; secondary **Back** → `?step=club`.

### View: you (Step 4 of 4, or 3 of 3), DecisionFlow

- question **Who is answering?**
- explainer **We keep your name with your answer, so {club} knows who decided.**
- `action` = `guardianDecisionAction`; hidden `token`, `club`, `scouts` (`no` when `club=no`).
- Children, in order:
  1. Answer summary, `div.wl-card` (`surface-raised`, `line`): `p.label.text-ink-muted` **Your answers**, then `p.body-lg` **Club stats: Yes** and **Scouts: No** (the words, never ticks alone), then `Link.body.text-pitch.underline` **Change my answers** → `?step=club`.
  2. Field, label `label.body-lg` **Your full name**: `input.wl-input.wl-decision__input.body-lg name="guardianName" autoComplete="name" maxLength={120} required`.
  3. Nested `fieldset` with `legend.body-lg` **How are you related to {first}?**, four `DecisionChoice` cards, `name="relationship"`: **Parent**, **Legal guardian**, **Grandparent**, **Other relative**. None pre-checked.
  4. One checkbox card, `label.wl-decision__choice.wl-decision__choice--top.body-lg` with `input type="checkbox" name="confirm" required`: **I am {first}'s parent or guardian and I am 18 or over.**
- submitLabel **Save my answer**; secondary **Back** → `?step=scouts&club=yes` or `?step=club`.
- Pending (with JavaScript): `SubmitButton` pending label **Saving…**.

**Server errors.** The action re-checks the token, then validates. On a validation error it redirects to the same step with the carried answers and `error=<code>`, which maps to fixed copy in the DecisionFlow `error` slot (`Banner tone="danger"`, `role="alert"`). The typed name is not carried back (no names in URLs).

| Code | Copy |
|---|---|
| `name` | Enter your full name. |
| `relationship` | Choose how you are related to {first}. |
| `confirm` | Tick the box to confirm you are {first}'s parent or guardian and 18 or over. |
| `answers` | Your answers were not clear. Please answer the questions again. (links back to `?step=club`) |
| `closed` | Redirect to the entry view, which shows the closed state. |

On success: redirect to `?step=done`.

### View: done

- `h1.heading-1` **Thank you. Your answer is saved.**
- Summary `div.wl-card.mt-6` as a `dl` (`wl-facts`): **Club stats** Yes or No; **Scouts** Yes or No (left out when club stats is No); **Saved on** `formatDate`.
- `p.body-lg.mt-6` **Keep this link. You can use it to change your mind at any time.**
- When state is granted: `ButtonLink variant="danger" block` **Stop sharing {first}'s stats** → `?step=withdraw`. When mode is `decide`: `ButtonLink variant="secondary" block` **Change my answer** → `?step=club` (above the danger button).
- Refusal (state none): same view; summary shows **Club stats: No**; no stop button.

### View: your answer (returning visitor, state granted)

- `h1.heading-1` **Your answer for {first}**.
- Same summary card, with **Answered on**.
- `p.body-lg.mt-6`: mode `decide` **You can change your answer or stop sharing at any time.** Mode `withdraw_only` **You can stop sharing at any time. To change anything else, ask {club} for a new link.**
- Buttons as in done (Change my answer only in mode `decide`).

### View: withdraw (stop sharing)

Not a DecisionFlow (a confirmation, not a choice):

- `h1.heading-1` **Stop sharing {first}'s stats?**
- `p.body-lg.mt-3` **The club and scouts stop seeing {first}'s stats straight away. We keep no new stats, and we remove {first} from clips, searches and saved lists within 24 hours.**
- `form action={guardianWithdrawAction}` with hidden `token`: `Button variant="danger" block type="submit"` **Stop sharing**, pending **Stopping…**.
- `ButtonLink variant="ghost" block` **Keep sharing** → `/consent/{token}`.

On success: redirect to `?step=stopped`.

### View: stopped

- `h1.heading-1` **{first}'s stats are no longer shared**.
- `p.body-lg.mt-3` **{club} and scouts can no longer see them.** Then, mode `decide`: **If you change your mind, you can use this link again.** Otherwise: **If you change your mind, ask {club}.**

### Closed views

Each is `EmptyState headingLevel={1}`, art off, inside the column.

| Case | Title | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Unknown token | This link does not work | Check that you opened the whole link. If it still does not work, ask the club for a new one. |
| Expired, nothing granted | This link has expired | Consent links work for 14 days. Ask {club} to send you a new one. |
| Revoked or replaced | This link no longer works | {club} turned off this link or sent a newer one. Use the newest link from {club}, or ask them for a new one. |
| Player turned 18 (mode `decide` but the player is 18 or over today) | {first} is now 18 | {first} can now decide for themselves. Ask {club} to record {first}'s own answer. |
| Player departed, nothing granted | This link no longer works | {first} is no longer with {club}. If you have questions, ask {club}. |
| Unexpected server error (`consent/[token]/error.tsx`, client) | Something went wrong | Your answer was not saved. Try again in a few minutes. Button `primary` **Try again** (`reset`). |

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| 375 | One column, `space-4` gutters. Wordmark and club, then the step. Choice cards full width, 56px tall. Buttons full width, 48px, stacked (primary first). |
| 768 | Same column (576px), centred, `space-6` gutters. Primary and Back sit in one row (DecisionFlow `md:flex-row`). Done and your-answer buttons stay full width in the column. |
| 1280 | As 768, with more top space (`space-12`). The column never widens: reading length stays short. |

### States

- **Empty:** not applicable; every token resolves to one view.
- **Loading:** none. Pages are server-rendered and small. Submits show the pending label with JavaScript; without it, the browser's own loading indicator.
- **Error:** server errors as above; the error page for unexpected failures.
- **Forbidden:** not applicable (public). A revoked or replaced link is the closed view.
- **Partial data:** club name missing is impossible (tenant). A player with no first name cannot get a link (named players only).
- **Long content:** long club names and first names wrap (`break-words` on every heading). Choice labels wrap inside the card; the card grows.
- **Without JavaScript:** every step works. The only difference is no pending label.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order per step: radio group (arrow keys move, Space selects), then the primary button, then Back. In you: Change my answers link, name, relationship radios, the checkbox, Save, Back.
- Each step is a new page, so focus starts at the top of the document. The `h1` is the first heading, and the step caption sits just above it.
- The DecisionFlow `legend.sr-only` repeats the question for the radio group. The nested relationship fieldset has a visible legend.
- Error banners use `role="alert"`. The name input gets `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` the banner when `error=name`.
- The focus ring draws around the whole choice card (`:has(:focus-visible)`).

## Surface 2: club consent recording form, `/squad/players/[playerId]/consent`

**Who, where, job.** A club owner or admin, on a laptop with a signed paper form in hand, or on a phone with a parent next to them. One job: record what was decided for one player, by whom, how and when, and against which wording.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)`, `requireSquadOrgPage`, `getPlayer`. `notFound()` for a missing, foreign, opposition or placeholder player. Metadata title: **Consent for {name}**.

### Structure (DOM order)

1. `PageHeader`: back `{ href: "/squad/players/{id}", label: "{name}" }`; eyebrow **Consent**; title **Record consent for {name}** (state none, requested or withdrawn) or **Change consent for {name}** (state club_only or scout_visible); intro (`body text-ink-muted`):
   - Minor: **{first} is under 18, so a parent or guardian decides. Record what they chose, and how.**
   - No date of birth: **We do not have {first}'s date of birth, so we treat {first} as under 18. A parent or guardian decides.**
   - Adult: **{first} is 18 or over and decides for themselves. Record what they chose, and how.**
2. Current state line, `p.mt-4.wl-row`: `ConsentBadge` plus `span.body.text-ink-muted` **Current consent, recorded {date}** (no rows: **No consent recorded yet**).
3. `section.wl-card.mt-8.max-w-3xl` containing `ConsentForm` (client), `form.flex.flex-col.gap-6` with `noValidate`, `FormBusy`, hidden `playerId`.

### ConsentForm fields (DOM order)

| # | Block | Control | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Who decided (minor) | `Field` text `name="grantedBy" autoComplete="off" maxLength={120}` | Label **Parent or guardian's full name**. Hint **As it is written on the form, or as they told you.** |
| 2 | | `fieldset` of `wl-choice` radios in `.wl-choice-row`, `name="relationship"` | Legend (`label`) **How are they related to {first}?** Options **Parent**, **Legal guardian**, **Grandparent**, **Other relative**. Hint under the legend (`caption text-ink-muted`) **They must be {first}'s parent, or someone who legally cares for {first}.** |
| 1 (adult) | Who decided | `p.body` | **The player decides: {name}.** Hidden `relationship=self`. No name field (the server uses the player's name). |
| 3 | How | `fieldset` of `wl-choice` radios, `name="method"` | Legend **How did they give their answer?** Options **Signed paper form**, **In person**, **By email**. |
| 4 | When | `Field` `input type="date" name="grantedAt"` with `max` today, default today | Label **Date of the decision**. Hint **The day they signed, or told you.** |
| 5 | Wording | `p.label` **What they were shown**, then `ConsentWording audience={minor ? "guardian" : "player"} headingLevel={3} framed={false}` | Below it, `Link.body.text-pitch.underline` **Print the paper form** → `consent/print`. |
| 6 | Club stats | `fieldset` of `wl-choice` radios, `name="clubStats"` | Legend **Can {club} record {first}'s stats?** Options **Yes** and **No**. |
| 7 | Scouts | `fieldset` of `wl-choice` radios, `name="scoutVisible"` | Legend **Can scouts see {first}'s stats?** Hint **Only possible if the club can record them.** Options **Yes, scouts can see them** and **No, keep them inside the club**. |
| 8 | Confirmation | `label.wl-choice.wl-choice--top` with checkbox `name="seenWording"` | **The person deciding saw this wording (version {version}).** Version in `span.data`. |
| 9 | | `FormErrorBanner` | |
| 10 | | `SubmitButton variant="primary"` | **Save consent**, pending **Saving…**. Full width under 768px. |

Block 5 detail: the wording sits on a `div.bg-surface-sunken.rounded-md.p-4` well, so it reads as quoted text. Its block title is a `p.label`, not a heading, so the wording's h3s sit under the card's h2. Every radio group starts with nothing checked.

Group the blocks with `h2.heading-2` section titles inside the card, each `mt-2` after a `border-t border-line pt-6` divider (none before the first): **Who decided** (1 to 2), **How and when** (3 to 4), **What they chose** (5 to 8).

### Outcome copy

The server maps the answers to a state (plan step 7). On success it redirects to `/squad/players/{id}?done=consent`. The player page shows `Banner ok` **Consent saved. {first}'s consent is now {badge label}.**, with the label read from the database.

### Field and form errors

| Case | Field | Copy |
|---|---|---|
| Name empty | grantedBy | Enter the full name of the parent or guardian. |
| Name too long | grantedBy | Use 120 characters or fewer. |
| No relationship | relationship | Choose how they are related to {first}. |
| No method | method | Choose how they gave their answer. |
| No date | grantedAt | Enter the date of the decision. |
| Future date | grantedAt | The date cannot be in the future. |
| Date before birth | grantedAt | The date cannot be before {first} was born. |
| Adult form, but under 18 on that date | grantedAt | {first} was under 18 on this date, so a parent or guardian must decide. Change the date, or ask a guardian. |
| No club answer | clubStats | Choose yes or no for club stats. |
| No scouts answer | scoutVisible | Choose yes or no for scouts. |
| Scouts yes, club no | scoutVisible | Scouts can only see stats the club records. Choose No for scouts, or Yes for club stats. |
| Box not ticked | seenWording | Confirm that they saw this wording. |
| Player departed (form) | | {first} has left the club, so you cannot record new consent. You can still withdraw it on {first}'s page. |
| Player gone (form) | | This player no longer exists. |
| Anything else (form) | | Consent was not saved. Try again. |

Errors on radio groups: render `FieldErrorText` under the legend, give the `fieldset` `aria-describedby` pointing at it and `data-invalid="true"`, and put `aria-invalid` on each radio in the group. `useFocusFirstInvalid` focuses the first radio of the first invalid group.

### Other states

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Coach | No form. `EmptyState art={false}` title **Only owners and admins can record consent**, body **Ask an owner or admin of {organisation} to record consent for {first}.**, action `ButtonLink secondary` **Back to {first}**. |
| Departed player | No form. `EmptyState art={false}` title **{first} has left the club**, body **The club cannot record new consent for a departed player. You can still withdraw consent on {first}'s page.**, action `ButtonLink secondary` **Back to {first}**. |
| Loading | Inherits `squad/players/[playerId]/loading.tsx` (DetailSkeleton). Submit shows the pending label and `aria-busy`. |
| Long content | Names wrap. The wording is long by design; the page scrolls, never an inner scroll box. |
| Empty, small sample | Not applicable. |

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| 375 | One column. Radio groups stack, one option per 44px row. Date input 44px. Save full width, 48px. |
| 768 | Card `max-w-3xl`. Radio groups in a row (`.wl-choice-row`); relationship wraps to 2 rows. |
| 1280 | As 768. The card stays `max-w-3xl` for reading length; the right side of the page stays empty. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: back link, name, relationship group, method group, date, Print the paper form, club group, scouts group, checkbox, Save. Arrow keys move inside each radio group. Each `fieldset` has a visible `legend`. After a failed submit, focus goes to the first invalid control and the field error is announced through `aria-describedby`.

## Surface 3: printable paper consent form, `/squad/players/[playerId]/consent/print`

**Who, where, job.** A club admin or coach prints it in the club office; a parent fills it in by hand at training or at home. One job: capture a signed decision on paper, with the exact wording and version, for the club to record later.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(CLUB_ROLES)`, `requireSquadOrgPage`; `notFound()` as Surface 2. Departed players: the page renders, but with the note **{first} has left the club. Use this form only to record a withdrawal.** Metadata title: **Paper consent form for {name}**.

### Structure

1. Screen-only toolbar, `div.wl-print-hide`: `PageHeader` with back `{ href: "/squad/players/{id}", label: "{name}" }`, title **Paper consent form**, intro **Print this form and give it to {minor ? "{first}'s parent or guardian" : first}. When it comes back signed, record the answer on Wideline.** Actions: `Button variant="primary" icon={Printer}` **Print** (client: `window.print()`). A `noscript` caption: **Use your browser's print command.**
2. `ThemeScope theme="light"` → `article.wl-paper.mt-8` (forced light):
   1. `p.font-display.heading-2` **Wideline**, `p.eyebrow.text-ink-muted` the club name.
   2. `h1.heading-1` **Consent for {name}**.
   3. `dl.wl-facts.mt-4`: **Player** {name}; **Date of birth** {formatDate}; **Team** {teamLabel} (left out when missing).
   4. `section.wl-paper__section`: `ConsentWording audience framed={false} headingLevel={2}` (body-lg).
   5. `section.wl-paper__section`, `h2.heading-2` **Your answers**. `p.body-lg` **Tick one box for each question.**
      - `p.body-lg.body-strong` **1. Can {club} record {first}'s stats?** Then two `.wl-paper__option` rows: box + **Yes, the club can record them**; box + **No, do not record them**.
      - `p.body-lg.body-strong` **2. Can scouts see {first}'s stats?** `p.caption` **Only answer this if you said yes to question 1.** Options: **Yes, scouts can see them**; **No, keep them inside the club**.
   6. `section.wl-paper__section`, `h2.heading-2` **Who is answering**.
      - Minor: `.wl-paper__line` with label **Your full name**; `p.body-lg` **How are you related to {first}?** then four options with boxes (**Parent**, **Legal guardian**, **Grandparent**, **Other relative**); a box option **I am {first}'s parent or guardian and I am 18 or over.**
      - Adult: `.wl-paper__line` **Your full name**; box option **I am 18 or over and I decide for myself.**
      - Then two lines side by side from 768px: **Signature** and **Date**.
   7. `section.wl-paper__section` with a `line` top border: `p.label.text-ink-muted` **For the club**, then lines **Recorded on Wideline by** and **Date recorded**.
   8. `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-8` **Wording version {version}** (version in `span.data`). This line prints on every copy, so the recorded version matches the paper.

### States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Coach | Allowed: coaches hand out forms. Same page. |
| Departed | Note above the sheet (`p.body.text-ink-muted.wl-print-hide`), sheet unchanged. |
| No date of birth | Treated as a minor. Date of birth fact shows `Missing`. |
| Long content | The sheet runs to 2 A4 pages. `break-inside: avoid` keeps each section whole. |
| Loading | DetailSkeleton (inherited). |
| Empty, error, small sample | Not applicable beyond `notFound()` and the app error page. |

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| 375 | Toolbar stacks; Print full width. Sheet padding `space-4`; option rows and lines stack. |
| 768 | Sheet 768px wide; Signature and Date share a row. |
| 1280 | Sheet centred at 768px. |
| Print | Shell, toolbar and back link hidden. Sheet has no border or padding; light theme whatever the system setting. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

Tab order: back link, Print. The sheet has no controls: tick boxes are `span.wl-paper__box` with `aria-hidden`, and each option's words carry the meaning. The sheet is an `article` labelled by its `h1`.

---

## Surface 4: consent section on the player page, `/squad/players/[playerId]`

**Who, where, job.** Club admins see and change a player's consent; coaches check it before a match. One job: know the player's consent right now, and act on it.

**Placement.** A new section **Consent** (`id="consent"`), first after the hero, before Details. Section order for named players: Consent, Details, Consent history, Leaving the club (or Undo departure). Placeholders get neither consent section.

### Content, `section` → `div.wl-card.max-w-3xl`

1. Live region `div[aria-live="polite"].empty:mt-0` at the top of the card: success banners for this section (below).
2. State line, `div.wl-row`: `ConsentBadge`, then `p.body` the state sentence (Labels table).
3. Facts (`dl.wl-facts.mt-4`), only when the newest row is a decision (none after a refusal, club_only, scout_visible, withdrawn):

   | Label | Value |
   |---|---|
   | Club stats | Yes / No |
   | Scouts can see stats | Yes / No |
   | Decided by | **{grantedBy}** ({relationship}); self: **{name}** (the player) |
   | How | method label |
   | Date | formatDate of grantedAt or withdrawnAt |
   | Recorded by | user name; null with method guardian_link: **The guardian, through the link**; null otherwise: **A former member** |
   | Wording | **Version {version}**, in `data`, then a native `details` with `summary.body.text-pitch.underline` **Show the wording** and `ConsentWording framed={false} headingLevel={3}` inside |

4. Open link line, when a guardian link is open and not expired: `p.body.mt-4.wl-inline-status` with `Hourglass` icon **A guardian link is open until {date}.**
5. Copy box, only right after a link is created (from the action result in client state; never from the URL), `div.mt-4.wl-card.bg-surface-sunken`:
   - `h3.body-strong` **Guardian link for {first}**
   - `div.wl-copybox.mt-2`: `label.sr-only` **Guardian link**; `input.wl-input.data readOnly` with the URL (focus selects all); `Button variant="secondary" icon={Copy}` **Copy link** → after copying **Copied** with `Check` for 2 seconds; `Button variant="secondary" icon={Share2}` **Share link**, rendered only when `navigator.share` exists (after hydration).
   - `p.body.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Send this link to {first}'s parent or guardian by WhatsApp or SMS, or hand them your phone to answer now. Anyone with the link can answer, so send it only to them. It works until {date}.**
   - `p.caption.mt-2.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--warn` with `Clock` **You will not see this link again after you leave this page. If it is lost, create a new one.**
6. Actions, `div.wl-row.mt-6` (owners and admins only), in this order, each shown only when it applies:

   | Action | Shown when | Control |
   |---|---|---|
   | **Record consent** / **Change consent** | active player | `ButtonLink secondary icon={ShieldCheck}` → `consent`. "Change" when state is granted. |
   | **Ask a guardian** | active, under 18 or no date of birth, no open link | `form action={requestConsentAction}` with `SubmitButton variant="secondary"`, pending **Creating link…** |
   | **Create a new link** | as above, but a link is open | `ConfirmDialog` trigger `secondary`. Title **Create a new guardian link?** Body **The link you made on {date} stops working. Send the new link to {first}'s parent or guardian.** Submit `primary` **Create new link**, pending **Creating link…**. |
   | **Turn off link** | a link is open | `ConfirmDialog` trigger `ghost`. Title **Turn off the guardian link?** Body **The link stops working at once. {first}'s consent stays as it is.** Submit `danger` **Turn off link**, pending **Turning off…**. |
   | **Print paper form** | active player (also coaches) | `ButtonLink ghost icon={Printer}` → `consent/print` |
   | **Withdraw consent** | state club_only or scout_visible (active or departed) | `ConfirmDialog` trigger `danger icon={ShieldOff}` (below) |

   Coaches see only Print paper form, then `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` **Only owners and admins can record or withdraw consent.**

### Withdraw consent dialog

- Title **Withdraw consent for {name}?**
- Body **The club and scouts stop seeing {first}'s stats straight away. Wideline keeps no new stats for {first}, and removes {first} from clips, searches and saved lists within 24 hours. You can record consent again later.**
- Fields:
  - `Field` **Who asked to withdraw?** `name="requestedBy" maxLength={120}`, hint **The parent or guardian, or {first} if 18 or over.**
  - Minor only: `fieldset` of `wl-choice` radios `name="relationship"`, legend **How are they related to {first}?** (Parent, Legal guardian, Grandparent, Other relative). Optional.
  - `fieldset` `name="method"`, legend **How did they ask?** (Signed paper form, In person, By email).
- Submit `danger` **Withdraw consent**, pending **Withdrawing…**.
- Errors: **Enter the name of the person who asked.**; **Choose how they asked.**; form: **Consent is already withdrawn.** (state changed meanwhile); **Consent was not withdrawn. Try again.**

### Success banners (live region, `Banner tone="ok"`)

| Result | Copy |
|---|---|
| `?done=consent` | Consent saved. {first}'s consent is now {badge label}. |
| Withdrawn | Consent withdrawn. Scouts and the club can no longer see {first}'s stats. |
| Link created | Guardian link created. Copy it below and send it. |
| Link turned off | Guardian link turned off. |

### States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| No rows | Badge **No consent**, sentence "No consent recorded yet…", no facts, actions as above. |
| Requested | Badge **Requested**, open link line, no facts. |
| Departed | Card as usual. Actions: Withdraw consent only (when granted). Under the actions `p.caption.text-ink-muted`: **{first} has left the club. You can withdraw consent, but not record new consent.** |
| Adult | No Ask a guardian. Facts show **Decided by {name} (the player)**. |
| No date of birth | Extra `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2` under the state line: **No date of birth, so {first} is treated as under 18. Add it under Details.** |
| Recorder removed | **A former member**. |
| Loading | DetailSkeleton. Buttons show pending labels. |
| Error | Action errors in the dialog (`FormErrorBanner`); Ask a guardian errors in the section live region as `Banner tone="danger"`: **The link was not created. Try again.**; over 18: **{first} is 18 or over and decides for themselves. Record their answer instead.** |
| Forbidden | Scouts and others: `/forbidden`. Coaches: read-only as above. |
| Long content | Guardian names and URLs wrap or scroll inside the input; never overflow the card. |

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| 375 | Badge and sentence wrap under each other. Facts stack (label above value). Copy box: input, then Copy link and Share link full width. Actions stack full width (`block`, 48px). |
| 768 | Card `max-w-3xl`. Facts in two columns (`wl-facts`). Copy box in one row. Actions in one wrapping row. |
| 1280 | As 768. |

### Keyboard, focus and screen readers

- Tab order: actions in the table order; Withdraw consent is always last, so a stray Tab-Enter never lands on it first.
- After `?done=consent` and after a withdrawal, focus moves to the Consent `h2` (`FocusHeadingOnMount` pattern), and the live region announces the banner. The withdraw trigger is gone after success, so focus must not be left on the closed dialog.
- After a link is created, focus moves to the **Copy link** button. Copying announces **Link copied.** through a `span.sr-only[aria-live="polite"]`.
- ConfirmDialog focus rules stand: first field, or Cancel when there is none.
- The `details` summary is keyboard-operable natively and reads "Show the wording, collapsed".

## Surface 5: consent history on the player page

**Who, where, job.** Club admins answering "who agreed to what, and when", for a parent's question or a POPIA request. One job: show every consent row, newest first, never edited.

**Placement.** Section **Consent history** (`id="consent-history"`), after Details, for every named player. Same view for coaches.

### Table (768px and up), `DataTable` caption **Consent history for {name}, newest first**

| Column | Header | Cell |
|---|---|---|
| when | **When** | `formatDateTime(createdAt)` in `data` |
| state | **Consent** | `ConsentBadge` |
| choices | **Choices** | **Club: Yes · Scouts: No**; requested rows `Missing` |
| who | **Decided by** | **{name}** with `span.caption.block.text-ink-muted` the relationship label; self: **{name}** / **The player**; requested rows `Missing` |
| how | **How** | method label; requested rows **Guardian link** |
| by | **Recorded by** | user name; **The guardian, through the link**; **A former member** |
| wording | **Wording** | version in `data`; `Missing` when none |

Withdrawn rows show **Club: No · Scouts: No**. Decided by for a withdrawn row is the person who asked.

### Phone cards (under 768px)

`li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-1`:

1. `div.wl-row`: `ConsentBadge`, `span.data.text-ink-muted` the date and time.
2. `p.body` **Club stats: Yes · Scouts: No** (left out for requested rows).
3. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Decided by {name} ({relationship}), {method label}** (requested: **Guardian link created**).
4. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Recorded by {name} · Wording {version}** (missing parts left out).

### Wording versions

Under the table, `div.mt-4`: one native `details` per distinct version in the history, `summary.body.text-pitch.underline` **Wording {version}**, containing `ConsentWording framed audience` (guardian when any row in that version has `playerWasMinor`, otherwise player; show both, guardian first, when both occur).

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Empty | `p.body.text-ink-muted` **No consent records yet. Records appear here when consent is recorded, requested or withdrawn.** No table, no art. |
| One row | Table with one row. |
| Long content | All rows, no pagination; the table scrolls inside its region (max 70vh) with a sticky header. Names wrap. |
| Loading | DetailSkeleton. |
| Partial data | Recorder deleted: **A former member**. Missing method or wording: `Missing`. |
| Error, forbidden | As the player page. |
| Small sample | Not applicable. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

The table region is focusable (`tabIndex={0}`) and labelled by its caption; arrow keys scroll it. Each `details` summary is a Tab stop. The badge text is read as written ("Scout-visible"), not in capitals.

## Surface 6: ConsentBadge in the squad list and player hero

**Who, where, job.** Club admins scan for consent gaps before a match; coaches check on a phone. One job: show every player's consent state at a glance.

### Squad list, `/squad`

- **Current table:** new column after Name: id `consent`, header **Consent**, cell `ConsentBadge state={p.consentState}`; placeholders `Missing`.
- **Departed table:** the same column after Name, so a departed player's withdrawal stays visible.
- **Phone cards:** after the meta line, `div.wl-row.mt-2` with `ConsentBadge` (named players only), then `ClubStatusChip` and the "Left on" caption for departed players (existing). The badge always comes first.
- `PlayerRow` gains `consentState`. No filter or sort by consent in C05 (the dashboard's consent gaps are C14).

### Player hero

`badges`: `ConsentBadge` first, then `ClubStatusChip` (departed only). Named players only. The badge is not a link; the Consent section is right below the hero.

### States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Every state | One of the five badges; colour, icon (none for No consent) and word together. |
| Placeholder | No badge; table cell `Missing`. |
| Empty squad | Existing C04 empty states, unchanged. |
| Loading | Existing ListSkeleton and DetailSkeleton. |
| Long content | The badge never wraps (`white-space: nowrap`); the Consent column stays narrow. At 768 the table already scrolls inside its region. |
| Forbidden | Scouts never reach these pages, so they never see the badge (component rule). |

### Layout

| Width | Layout |
|---|---|
| 375 | Card: avatar, name, meta, then the badge row. |
| 768 | Table column 2 is Consent; the table scrolls sideways inside its region if needed. |
| 1280 | All columns fit. |

### Screen readers

The column header gives context; the badge reads its word ("No consent", "Requested", "Club only", "Scout-visible", "Withdrawn"). Icons are `aria-hidden`.

## Tests the design adds

- e2e `consent.spec.ts` axe runs: guardian about, club, scouts, you, done, your answer, withdraw, stopped and each closed view; the record form (empty and with errors); the player page with the copy box open and with the withdraw dialog open; the history at 375 (cards) and 1280 (table); the print page. At 375, 768 and 1280, in light and dark.
- e2e: the guardian flow completes with JavaScript disabled (a second browser context with `javaScriptEnabled: false`).
- e2e: no radio or checkbox on the record form or guardian steps is checked on load.
- e2e: the print page in `emulateMedia({ media: "print" })` hides the shell and the toolbar.
- Unit: `formatDateTime()` in SAST; `CONSENT_STATE_SENTENCES` covers all five states.
